New issue 89 by jeffrey....@gmail.com: Remove explicit uniform priors in
examples
http://code.google.com/p/stan/issues/detail?id=89

Several examples in the documentation still used explicit uniform priors,
often without a upper bound in the variable declaration. These were
replaced with an upper bound in the variable declaration, and an implicit
uniform prior.
